subject: Vendor onboarding: preferred invoice channel and sample template request
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@nimbus.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood vendor set-up + invoice intake question

Hi Jordan,

We’re moving toward completing our vendor onboarding for Redwood and had a quick operational question before we submit the paperwork. Our AP team prefers to send scanned PDFs by email into a shared mailbox (they already use that flow with several vendors). Before we do that, can you confirm whether Redwood ingests scanned PDFs reliably, or if you recommend using the vendor portal (or SFTP) for better parsing?

Specifics from our side: we typically have a separate PO field in our ERP and put the PO number on the first line of the PDF. Sometimes the PDFs are multi-page and include a cover email. Will that cause issues? Any preferred invoice template you can share so we can align our output?

We'd also like to know the remittance address format you need and whether an initial test invoice would help validate ingestion. I’ve attached the onboarding form we were about to send (Nimbus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf).

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lee
Procurement Manager, Nimbus Analytics
procurement@nimbus.com

Attachment: Nimbus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor set-up + invoice intake question

Hi Samantha — great to hear from you, and thanks for sending the onboarding form. Short answer: portal (or SFTP) is preferable for predictable ingestion, but we support email-based scanned PDFs with a few caveats.

Key points:
- Preferred: upload via our vendor portal (link below) or SFTP for structured ingestion (fewer OCR errors).
- Email intake: acceptable, but please put the PO number in the filename and on the first page of the invoice (preferably in a dedicated field or line starting with "PO:"). If multi-page, ensure the supplier header (name, invoice #, date) is on the first page.
- Scans: high-quality PDF (300 DPI) reduces OCR failures. Avoid handwritten PO numbers — typed is best.
- Remittance: send as a clear block labeled "Remit To" with full address and ACH details if applicable. We’ll need the Tax ID/ VAT number on the invoice.
- Testing: yes — please send one test invoice to ap-invoices+test@redwood.com with subject line: "TEST: Nimbus invoice <PO#>". That will let us confirm mapping and give you the final template.

I’m attaching our current invoice template (RNW-invoice-template-v3.xlsx) and a short checklist for the test invoice. Karthik — can you confirm whether we can accept the cover email as-is (some partners include a human note) or if we require the invoice attachment only in the intake mailbox? Monica — please confirm the correct remit block format for vendors in the US so I can pass it back to Samantha.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor set-up + invoice intake question

Jordan / Monica — quick internal note on the intake flows so we have consistent guidance for Nimbus.

1) Email intake behavior: our parser looks for attachments first. If there is a single PDF attachment that contains the invoice, we process it. If the email body contains an embedded PDF or a forwarded message with multiple attachments, the parser will pick the attachment with recognizable invoice fields (invoice number, total, date). Cover emails are OK but please advise vendors to attach the invoice as a separate file and name it with the PO number.

2) Multi-page PDFs: acceptable, but we require the invoice identifier and PO on page 1. If their system stamps PO on a later page only, it often fails automated matching and goes to manual queue.

3) SFTP option: recommended for high-volume suppliers. Provide credentials and a folder path; we can onboard them and validate with a test root file.

4) Exceptions: if OCR confidence < 0.85 for required fields, the invoice will be routed to AP ops for manual review; that may add 2–5 business days.

Monica — see the suggested remit block below; confirm and I’ll put it in the vendor guidance doc.

Suggested remit block (for Nimbus to include on PDF):
Remit To:
Redwood Inference
Accounts Payable
123 Redwood Way
San Francisco, CA 94107
EIN: 12-3456789
ACH: Routing 111000025 Account 000123456789

Karthik
Senior Revenue Operations Manager

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick follow-up. Pulling together the final guidance so your AP can proceed: please see the bullets below and attached template.

Summary guidance for Nimbus:
- Best: use the vendor portal upload (https://portal.redwood.com/vendors) or SFTP for batch submission. This avoids OCR and lowers exception rates.
- If you must email: attach the invoice as a single PDF and include the PO number in the filename (e.g., "PO_789234_NimbusInvoice.pdf") and on the first page as "PO: 789234". Do not rely on a separate cover email to convey PO or totals.
- Use the attached RNW-invoice-template-v3.xlsx as the canonical structure. Required fields: Supplier name, Invoice number, Invoice date, PO#, Line-item description, Quantity, Unit price, Line total, Invoice total, Remit To block, Tax ID.
- For multi-page invoices, ensure supplier header and PO are visible on page 1.
- Testing: please send one TEST invoice to ap-invoices+test@redwood.com with subject "TEST: Nimbus invoice 789234". We’ll validate parsing and reply with any mapping tweaks.
- Turnaround: if an OCR/manual exception occurs we’ll notify you; expect an extra 2–5 business days for manual resolution.

I’ve attached the template and reattached Nimbus’s onboarding form for reference. Once you confirm, we’ll create the vendor record and share onboarding steps (DocuSign for W-9 and the remittance confirmation).

Best,
Jordan
